title: Incident state event v1
description: Value of messages on topic ops.incidents.events.v1, keyed by incidentId (A-0007). Consumers must ignore unknown properties; v1 only gains optional properties.

eventId.description: Unique event id; consumers deduplicate on it.

occurredAt.description: Time of the state change, UTC.

incidentId.description: Incident id; equal to the message key.

incidentVersion.description: Incident version after the change. Increases with every change of one incident; consumers drop events with a lower version than one already seen.

previousState.description: State before the change; null when the incident was created.

step.description: Workflow step that caused the change; null when no step did.

stepId.description: Id of the recorded step, for lookup through the REST API; null when no step did.

reasonCode.description: Machine-readable reason, present for ESCALATED, FAILED and REJECTED.
